reasons: Claimed status is compliant with no redline and no comment, which is the expected output for a compliant finding; nothing is being raised against the counterparty.

The cited text supports the classification: Section 10.2(a)'s consent gate is expressly subject to Sections 5.3, 7.4 and 7.6, and Sections 5.3/7.6 grant symmetric merger, consolidation, business-succession and affiliate-assignment carve-outs with only mechanical successor formalities (assumption agreement, Officer's Certificate/Opinion, Rating Agency notice) — at or above the fallback's 'successors with written notice'.

No change-of-control trigger exists: the phrase does not appear and no Vendor/Servicer termination, re-pricing or consent right keys off a change of control; Section 7.1 in fact bars the Servicer from resigning absent legal inability, so walk-away territory is avoided.

The rationale correctly treats the absence of a 'not unreasonably withheld' qualifier and of a competitor-assignment bar as minor sub-elements noted rather than flagged, consistent with the playbook's classification semantics.

Deterministic check (successor/affiliate carve-out present) is satisfied and corroborates the analysis; the Optional Acquisition/Redemption rights are correctly characterized as balance- and date-triggered rather than change-of-control exits.
